name: queueless
description: Smart appointment booking and live virtual queue platform for small clinics, salons and local businesses

scripts.up:services: docker compose up -d notification-service queue-service gateway
scripts.test:services: npm --prefix services/notification-service test && npm --prefix services/queue-service test
scripts.verify: npm --prefix packages/common run build && npm --prefix backend run docs:export && npm --prefix packages/contracts test && npm --prefix packages/common test && npm --prefix packages/messaging test && npm --prefix services/notification-service test && npm --prefix services/queue-service test && npm --prefix backend test && npm run gateway:lint && node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'); execSync('docker run --rm --entrypoint promtool -v \"'+process.cwd()+'/monitoring/prometheus:/etc/prometheus\" prom/prometheus:v2.55.1 check rules /etc/prometheus/rules/alerts.yml', {stdio:'inherit'})" && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
